# Speech fixture

`jfk.wav` is the 11-second real speech sample from [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/master/samples/jfk.wav) (SHA-256 `59dfb9a4acb36fe2a2affc14bacbee2920ff435cb13cc314a08c13f66ba7860e`). The upstream project distributes its sample with the MIT-licensed repository. It gives the optional native-ASR regression test a public, reproducible opening phrase.

The browser recording used to reproduce the vocabulary-prompt omission came from the private CIFAR interview. Its audio stays in the local Stellis data store and is not included here.
